[Unit]
Description=Gbot private XFCE desktop
ConditionPathExists=/var/lib/gbot/installed
[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=all
WorkingDirectory=%h
Environment=HOME=%h
RuntimeDirectory=gbot
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/gbot-desktop-session
Restart=on-failure
[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

#!/bin/bash
set -eu
# Only our final readiness event may notify systemd.
if [ -z "${GBOT_DESKTOP_NOTIFY_SOCKET:-}" ]; then
  gbot_notify_socket=$NOTIFY_SOCKET
  unset NOTIFY_SOCKET
  exec dbus-run-session -- env GBOT_DESKTOP_NOTIFY_SOCKET="$gbot_notify_socket" "$0"
fi
export DISPLAY=:1
export XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=XFCE XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP=xfce XDG_SESSION_TYPE=x11
export XAUTHORITY="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/gbot/Xauthority"
export GTK_MODULES=atk-bridge QT_ACCESSIBILITY=1 NO_AT_BRIDGE=0
export PATH=/opt/gbot/bin:$PATH
umask 077
xauth -f "$XAUTHORITY" add "$DISPLAY" MIT-MAGIC-COOKIE-1 "$(mcookie)"
Xtigervnc "$DISPLAY" -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost yes -rfbport 5900 -SecurityTypes None -AcceptPointerEvents=0 -AcceptKeyEvents=0 -AcceptCutText=0 -SendCutText=0 -nolisten tcp -auth "$XAUTHORITY" &
vnc=$!
trap 'kill "$vnc" "${xfce:-}" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$vnc" "${xfce:-}" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT HUP INT TERM
# Confirm this X server before publishing the session to SSH workers.
xset -display "$DISPLAY" q >/dev/null 2>&1 || { sleep 1; xset -display "$DISPLAY" q >/dev/null; }
xset s off
xset -dpms
xset s noblank
dbus-update-activation-environment DISPLAY XAUTHORITY GTK_MODULES QT_ACCESSIBILITY NO_AT_BRIDGE PATH XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP XDG_SESSION_TYPE
printf 'DISPLAY=%s\nXAUTHORITY=%s\nDBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=%s\nXDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=%s\nXDG_SESSION_DESKTOP=%s\nXDG_SESSION_TYPE=%s\n' "$DISPLAY" "$XAUTHORITY" "$DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS" "$XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP" "$XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP" "$XDG_SESSION_TYPE" > "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/gbot/desktop.env"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/xfce4/xfconf/xfce-perchannel-xml"
if [ ! -e "$HOME/.config/xfce4/xfconf/xfce-perchannel-xml/xfwm4.xml" ]; then
cat > "$HOME/.config/xfce4/xfconf/xfce-perchannel-xml/xfwm4.xml" <<'XML'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<channel name="xfwm4" version="1.0"><property name="general" type="empty"><property name="use_compositing" type="bool" value="false"/></property></channel>
XML
fi
startxfce4 &
xfce=$!
NOTIFY_SOCKET="$GBOT_DESKTOP_NOTIFY_SOCKET" systemd-notify --ready
wait -n "$vnc" "$xfce"

PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
PermitRootLogin no
X11Forwarding no
AllowUsers gbot
# populated from reviewed artifact URLs and SHA-256 digests

[Unit]
Description=Gbot Cua desktop media
Requires=gbot-desktop.service
After=gbot-desktop.service
BindsTo=gbot-desktop.service
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/gbot-media
Restart=on-failure
[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
media_state="$HOME/.local/state/gbot/media"
install -d -m 700 "$media_state"
if [ ! -s "$media_state/token" ]; then
  { mcookie; mcookie; } | tr -d "\n" > "$media_state/token"
fi
chmod 600 "$media_state/token"
exec /usr/local/bin/gbot-in-session /opt/gbot/bin/cua-spacesd serve --listen 127.0.0.1:3211 --quic-port 0 --cursor-probe false --no-mcp --no-driver --token-file "$media_state/token" --data-dir "$media_state"

runcmd: uid=$(id -u gbot); systemctl start user@$uid.service; runuser -u gbot -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/$uid/bus systemctl --user enable --now gbot-desktop.service gbot-media.service; runuser -u gbot -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/$uid/bus systemctl --user is-active --quiet gbot-desktop.service gbot-media.service; printf "GBOT_READY_KEY %s\n" "$(cat /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub)" > /dev/ttyS0
final_message: Gbot first-boot setup finished. Verify cloud-init, SSH, worker and the same-session desktop before Ready.
